name: meridian-corpus
description: The merge-blocking gate set (P2 Stage 1, Decision 2 of ../Rag/projects/vaultrag/p2-step-plan.md). 72 (query -> expected note) pairs over the frozen fixture vault in tests/eval/corpus/, which is a synthetic engineering knowledge base and never drifts. Written to be HARDER than a title-matchy set: most queries are paraphrases sharing no distinctive token with the expected note's title, several notes cover neighbouring topics so ranking must discriminate, and a handful are identifier/error-code lookups that exercise the BM25 half of hybrid search. Targets (evaluation-framework.md): recall@10 >= 0.9, MRR@5 >= 0.75. Run: uv run vaultrag eval
